Here 'provided' means 'on the condition that' and joins two clauses, so it is a conjunction.
এখানে 'provided' অর্থ 'এই শর্তে যে' এবং এটি দুটি clause যুক্ত করে, তাই এটি conjunction।

questions.question: The prefix 'mis-' can be added to ----.
questions.explanation:
The prefix 'mis-' combines with 'fire' to form the real word 'misfire,' so 'fire' is correct.
'mis-' prefix 'fire'-এর সঙ্গে যুক্ত হয়ে প্রকৃত শব্দ 'misfire' গঠন করে, তাই 'fire' সঠিক।

questions.question: Just now he ---- his dinner but he says he will see you when he's finished.
questions.explanation:
The clause 'he will see you when he's finished' shows the dinner is still going on, so the present continuous 'is having' is correct.
'He will see you when he's finished' অংশটি বোঝায় রাতের খাবার এখনো চলছে, তাই present continuous 'is having' সঠিক।

questions.question: Find out the correct sentence.
options: It is raining since four days
It has been raining for four days
It is raining for four days
It has been raining since four days
questions.explanation:
A period of time takes 'for' with the present perfect continuous, so 'It has been raining for four days' is correct.
সময়ের ব্যাপ্তি বোঝাতে present perfect continuous-এর সঙ্গে 'for' বসে, তাই 'It has been raining for four days' সঠিক।

questions.question: I need some books, ----?
questions.explanation:
Here 'need' is an affirmative main verb, so the negative tag question 'don't I?' is correct.
এখানে 'need' হ্যাঁ-বাচক main verb, তাই নেতিবাচক tag question 'don't I?' সঠিক।

questions.question: Hardly ---- I entered the room ---- the phone rang.
questions.explanation:
The structure is 'Hardly had + subject + past participle ... before/when ...,' which requires 'had' and 'before' here.
'Hardly had + subject + past participle ... before/when ...' গঠনে এখানে 'had' ও 'before' দরকার।

questions.question: If I ---- you, I would not have done this.
questions.explanation:
In an unreal condition, 'were' is used for all subjects, so 'If I were you' is correct.
অবাস্তব শর্তে সব subject-এর জন্য 'were' ব্যবহৃত হয়, তাই 'If I were you' সঠিক।

questions.question: We saw them ---- to university.
questions.explanation:
After the perception verb 'saw,' the present participle 'going' is used to show an action in progress.
Perception verb 'saw'-এর পরে চলমান কাজ বোঝাতে present participle 'going' ব্যবহৃত হয়, তাই এটি সঠিক।

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: The traffic are unmanageable in Dhaka.
The traffic is unmanageable in Dhaka.
The traffics are manageable in Dhaka.
The traffics are uncontrollable in Dhaka.
questions.explanation:
'Traffic' is an uncountable noun and takes a singular verb, so 'The traffic is unmanageable' is correct.
'Traffic' একটি uncountable noun এবং এর সঙ্গে singular verb বসে, তাই 'The traffic is unmanageable' সঠিক।

questions.question: 'Bootleg' means to ----.
questions.explanation:
The word 'bootleg' means to smuggle or to trade goods illegally.
'Bootleg' শব্দের অর্থ চোরাচালান করা বা অবৈধভাবে পণ্য কেনাবেচা করা।

questions.question: There is ---- milk in the bottle.
questions.explanation:
'Milk' is uncountable, and 'a little' expresses a small but positive amount, so 'a little' is correct.
'Milk' uncountable, এবং 'a little' অল্প কিন্তু ইতিবাচক পরিমাণ বোঝায়, তাই 'a little' সঠিক।

questions.question: The word 'everything' is ----.
questions.explanation:
'Everything' stands in place of a noun, so it is a pronoun.
'Everything' noun-এর পরিবর্তে বসে, তাই এটি একটি pronoun।

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: The man appears to be stronger than other living men.
The man appears to be stronger than many living men.
The man appears to be stronger than all other living men.
The man appears to be stronger than any other living man.
questions.explanation:
The pattern 'than any other' is followed by a singular noun, so 'any other living man' is correct.
'Than any other'-এর পরে singular noun বসে, তাই 'any other living man' সঠিক।

questions.question: In fear of ---- he escaped elsewhere.
questions.explanation:
The passive gerund 'being arrested' is needed after 'in fear of,' since he feared the action being done to him.
'In fear of'-এর পরে passive gerund 'being arrested' দরকার, কারণ তিনি নিজের প্রতি কাজটি ঘটার ভয় পেয়েছিলেন, তাই এটি সঠিক।

questions.question: The word 'Survival' is a/an ----.
questions.explanation:
'Survival' is formed by adding '-al' to the verb 'survive' and names a thing, so it is a noun.
'Survive' verb-এর সঙ্গে '-al' যোগ করে 'survival' গঠিত হয় এবং এটি একটি জিনিস/অবস্থা বোঝায়, তাই এটি noun।

questions.question: I must ---- you to do the work.
questions.explanation:
The causative structure 'get + object + to + base verb' fits here, so 'get' is correct.
এখানে causative গঠন 'get + object + to + base verb' মানানসই, তাই 'get' সঠিক।

questions.question: Choose the incorrect sentence.
questions.explanation:
'Sky' is a unique thing and takes the definite article 'the,' so 'A sky is blue' is the incorrect sentence.
'Sky' একটি অনন্য বস্তু এবং এর আগে definite article 'the' বসে, তাই 'A sky is blue' বাক্যটি ভুল।

questions.question: I suggest that he ---- there.
questions.explanation:
After 'suggest that', the verb stays in its base (subjunctive) form, so 'go' is correct.
'suggest that'-এর পরে ক্রিয়াটি তার মূল রূপে (subjunctive) বসে, তাই 'go' সঠিক।

questions.question: Education is enlightening. Here 'enlightening' is:
questions.explanation:
Here 'enlightening' is a present participle (verb + -ing) describing 'education'.
এখানে 'enlightening' একটি বর্তমান কৃদন্ত (participle, verb + -ing), যা 'education'-কে বর্ণনা করছে।

questions.question: An adverb does not modify:
questions.explanation:
An adverb modifies verbs, adjectives and other adverbs, but it does not modify nouns.
Adverb ক্রিয়া, বিশেষণ ও অন্য adverb-কে modify করে, কিন্তু বিশেষ্য (noun)-কে modify করে না।

questions.question: A cow is ---- than an elephant.
questions.explanation:
A cow is smaller in size than an elephant, so 'smaller' is correct.
একটি গরু হাতির চেয়ে আকারে ছোট, তাই 'smaller' সঠিক।

questions.question: Onion prices have ---- too much this month.
questions.explanation:
'Rise' is intransitive and its past participle is 'risen', so 'have risen' is correct.
'Rise' একটি অকর্মক ক্রিয়া এবং এর past participle হলো 'risen', তাই 'have risen' সঠিক।

questions.question: The principal, along with his students, ---- planting trees for two hours.
questions.explanation:
'Along with' does not change the number of the subject, so the singular 'principal' takes 'has been'.
'Along with' মূল কর্তার বচন পরিবর্তন করে না, তাই একবচন 'principal'-এর সাথে 'has been' বসে।

questions.question: Change into the negative form: 'He is too weak to walk.'
options: He is very weak to walk.
He is so weak that he cannot walk.
He is not very much weak.
questions.explanation:
The 'too...to' structure becomes negative as 'so...that...cannot', giving 'He is so weak that he cannot walk.'
'too...to' গঠনটি নেতিবাচক হলে 'so...that...cannot' হয়, তাই 'He is so weak that he cannot walk.' সঠিক।

questions.question: ---- others is a great deed.
questions.explanation:
An infinitive ('To help') can act as the subject of a sentence, so 'To help' is correct.
Infinitive ('To help') বাক্যের কর্তা হিসেবে বসতে পারে, তাই 'To help' সঠিক।

questions.question: I fancy I ---- a trifle pale.
questions.explanation:
The sentence describes a past change of colour, so the past form 'turned' is correct.
বাক্যটি অতীতে বর্ণের একটি পরিবর্তন বোঝাচ্ছে, তাই অতীত রূপ 'turned' সঠিক।

questions.question: The word 'American' is:
questions.explanation:
'American' can be used both as a noun (a person from America) and as an adjective (American culture).
'American' শব্দটি বিশেষ্য (আমেরিকার একজন মানুষ) এবং বিশেষণ (American culture) — উভয় রূপেই ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: This necklace is made of gold. In the sentence, 'gold' is a/an:
questions.explanation:
'Gold' names a material or substance, so it is a material noun.
'Gold' একটি পদার্থের নাম, তাই এটি material noun (বস্তুবাচক বিশেষ্য)।

questions.question: Liza had given me two ----.
questions.explanation:
After 'two' we need the plural 'pairs', so 'two pairs of jeans' is correct.
'Two'-এর সাথে বহুবচন 'pairs' প্রয়োজন, তাই 'two pairs of jeans' সঠিক।

questions.question: There are ---- dangerous drivers.
questions.explanation:
'A lot of' correctly means 'many' before a plural countable noun like 'drivers'.
বহুবচন গণনাযোগ্য বিশেষ্য 'drivers'-এর আগে 'a lot of' সঠিকভাবে 'অনেক' বোঝায়।

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: He is speaks the English like English.
He speaks English like the English.
He speaks the English like the English.
questions.explanation:
'The English' means the English people, so 'He speaks English like the English' is correct.
'The English' অর্থ ইংরেজ জাতি, তাই 'He speaks English like the English' সঠিক।

questions.question: 'Black Death' is the name of a:
questions.explanation:
The 'Black Death' was a devastating plague pandemic in the 14th century.
'Black Death' ছিল চতুর্দশ শতকের একটি ভয়াবহ প্লেগ মহামারি।

questions.question: Seeing is ----.
questions.explanation:
'Seeing is believing' is a fixed proverb that uses the gerund 'believing'.
'Seeing is believing' একটি প্রবাদ, যেখানে gerund 'believing' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: Identify the word that can be used as both singular and plural:
questions.explanation:
'Fish' keeps the same form in both singular and plural.
'Fish' শব্দটি একবচন ও বহুবচনে একই রূপে থাকে।

questions.question: I am looking for someone who ---- play the piano.
questions.explanation:
'Can' alone expresses ability and correctly fits after 'who', so 'who can play the piano' is correct.
'Can' একাই সামর্থ্য বোঝায় এবং 'who'-এর পরে সঠিকভাবে বসে, তাই 'who can play the piano' সঠিক।

questions.question: He ran fast lest he ---- miss the train.
questions.explanation:
After 'lest' we use 'should' + base verb, so 'lest he should miss' is correct.
'Lest'-এর পরে 'should' + মূল ক্রিয়া বসে, তাই 'lest he should miss' সঠিক।

questions.question: Which of the following nouns is used in the feminine form?
questions.explanation:
By tradition the moon is treated as feminine in English.
প্রথাগতভাবে ইংরেজিতে চাঁদ (moon)-কে স্ত্রীলিঙ্গ ধরা হয়।

questions.question: There is no use ---- buying the book.
questions.explanation:
The idiom here is 'there is no use of + gerund', so 'of' is used.
এখানে বাগধারাটি হলো 'there is no use of + gerund', তাই 'of' বসে।

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: He is poorest of the two.
He is poorer of the two.
He is more poor of the two.
He is much poor of the two.
questions.explanation:
With 'of the two' we use the comparative degree, so 'poorer of the two' is correct.
'Of the two'-এর সাথে তুলনামূলক ডিগ্রি বসে, তাই 'poorer of the two' সঠিক।

questions.question: Which of the following is a simple sentence?
options: I know the man who came here.
The man who came here is my brother.
The principal of our college is always ready to help the students.
questions.explanation:
A simple sentence has only one independent clause and no subordinate clause, which option (d) satisfies.
Simple sentence-এ একটিমাত্র স্বাধীন খণ্ডবাক্য থাকে, কোনো অধীন খণ্ডবাক্য থাকে না; (d) সেই শর্ত পূরণ করে।

questions.question: Find the correct sentence:
options: Over a billion people uses Microsoft Windows Operating Systems.
Over a billion people use Microsoft Windows Operating Systems.
Over a billion peoples use Microsoft Windows Operating Systems.
Over a billion people using Microsoft Windows Operating Systems.
questions.explanation:
'People' is a plural noun and takes the plural verb 'use'.
'People' একটি বহুবচন বিশেষ্য এবং এর সাথে বহুবচন ক্রিয়া 'use' বসে।

questions.question: Change into active voice: 'Am I wanted by you?'
questions.explanation:
The active voice of 'Am I wanted by you?' is 'Do you want me?'
'Am I wanted by you?'-এর active voice হলো 'Do you want me?'

questions.question: The correct passive form of 'You must shut these doors' is:
questions.explanation:
In the passive, the object 'these doors' becomes the subject: 'These doors must be shut.'
Passive-এ কর্ম 'these doors' কর্তা হয়ে যায়: 'These doors must be shut.'

questions.question: I couldn't mend the computer myself, so I ---- at a shop.
questions.explanation:
The causative structure 'had + object + past participle' gives 'had it mended'.
Causative গঠন 'had + object + past participle' অনুসারে 'had it mended' সঠিক।

questions.question: Who, Which, What, Whom are:
questions.explanation:
Who, Which, What and Whom are relative pronouns that connect clauses.
Who, Which, What ও Whom হলো relative pronoun, যা খণ্ডবাক্য যুক্ত করে।

questions.question: Please stop before you ---- into trouble.
questions.explanation:
After 'before' we use the simple present, so 'before you get into trouble' is correct.
'Before'-এর পরে present indefinite বসে, তাই 'before you get into trouble' সঠিক।

questions.question: The plural form of 'Ox' is:
questions.explanation:
The irregular plural of 'ox' is 'oxen'.
'Ox'-এর অনিয়মিত বহুবচন হলো 'oxen'।

questions.question: Choose the correct indirect narration of: 'Why have you beaten my dog?' he said to me.
options: He demanded me why had I beaten his dog.
He asked me why I have had beaten his dog.
He enquired me why had I had beaten his dog.
He demanded of me why I had beaten his dog.
questions.explanation:
In indirect speech the present perfect 'have beaten' becomes the past perfect 'had beaten', so 'He demanded of me why I had beaten his dog' is correct.
পরোক্ষ উক্তিতে present perfect 'have beaten' পরিবর্তিত হয়ে past perfect 'had beaten' হয়, তাই 'He demanded of me why I had beaten his dog' সঠিক।

questions.question: I ---- to meet you ever since I read your first novel.
questions.explanation:
'Ever since' with a continuing action needs the present perfect continuous, 'have been hoping'.
চলমান কাজ বোঝাতে 'ever since'-এর সাথে present perfect continuous 'have been hoping' বসে।

questions.question: When water ----, it turns into ice.
questions.explanation:
For a general truth after 'when', we use the simple present, so 'freezes' is correct.
'When'-এর পরে চিরসত্য বোঝাতে present indefinite বসে, তাই 'freezes' সঠিক।

questions.question: ---- the letter tonight, Rana will post it tomorrow.
questions.explanation:
A present participle phrase ('Finishing the letter tonight') can begin the sentence, so 'Finishing' is correct.
বাক্যের শুরুতে present participle phrase ('Finishing the letter tonight') বসতে পারে, তাই 'Finishing' সঠিক।

questions.question: What is the meaning of 'Soft Soap'?
questions.explanation:
The idiom 'soft soap' means flattery used to serve one's own selfish motives.
'Soft soap' বাগধারার অর্থ নিজের স্বার্থসিদ্ধির জন্য তোষামোদ করা।

questions.question: The wall is made of bricks. The underlined word is a/an:
questions.explanation:
'Bricks' can be counted and made plural, so it is a countable noun.
'Bricks' গোনা যায় ও বহুবচন করা যায়, তাই এটি countable noun।

questions.question: ---- mother rose in her.
questions.explanation:
Here 'mother' refers to the maternal feeling within her, which takes the definite article 'the'.
এখানে 'mother' তার ভেতরের মাতৃত্বের অনুভূতি বোঝাচ্ছে, যার আগে নির্দিষ্ট আর্টিকেল 'the' বসে।

questions.question: More ivory is obtained from elephants in Africa ---- elephants in Asia.
questions.explanation:
The comparison repeats the preposition 'from', so 'than from elephants in Asia' is correct.
তুলনায় preposition 'from' পুনরাবৃত্ত হয়, তাই 'than from elephants in Asia' সঠিক।

questions.question: 'The boys saw him walking out.' Here 'walking' is a/an:
questions.explanation:
'Walking' here follows the object 'him' and describes it, so it is a present participle.
এখানে 'walking' কর্ম 'him'-এর পরে বসে তাকে বর্ণনা করছে, তাই এটি present participle।

questions.question: Rishan walks as if he ---- lame.
questions.explanation:
After 'as if' expressing an unreal situation, we use 'were', so 'as if he were lame' is correct.
অবাস্তব অবস্থা বোঝাতে 'as if'-এর পরে 'were' বসে, তাই 'as if he were lame' সঠিক।

questions.question: What ---- at this moment?
questions.explanation:
'At this moment' signals the present continuous tense, so 'What are you doing' is correct.
'At this moment' present continuous tense বোঝায়, তাই 'What are you doing' সঠিক।

questions.question: Come on, it's time to go home. Here 'home' is:
questions.explanation:
In 'go home', the word 'home' shows direction and functions as an adverb.
'Go home'-এ 'home' শব্দটি দিক নির্দেশ করে ও adverb হিসেবে কাজ করে।

questions.question: What is the noun form of the word 'Laugh'?
questions.explanation:
The noun form of the verb 'laugh' is 'laughter'.
'Laugh' ক্রিয়ার বিশেষ্য রূপ হলো 'laughter'।

questions.question: In English grammar, ---- deals with the formation of sentences.
questions.explanation:
'Syntax' is the branch of grammar that deals with how sentences are formed.
'Syntax' হলো ব্যাকরণের সেই শাখা যা বাক্য গঠন নিয়ে আলোচনা করে।

questions.question: They while their evenings with books and games. Here 'while' is a:
questions.explanation:
Here 'while' means to pass time and is used as a verb (to while away).
এখানে 'while' অর্থ সময় কাটানো এবং এটি verb হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

questions.question: Change the voice: 'Please keep quiet.'
options: You are requested to keep quiet.
You are requested for keep quiet.
You are asked to keep quiet.
You are told to keep quiet.
questions.explanation:
A polite request in the passive becomes 'You are requested to + verb', so option (a) is correct.
বিনীত অনুরোধের passive হয় 'You are requested to + verb', তাই (a) সঠিক।

questions.question: 'Duck' is the feminine gender of ----.
questions.explanation:
'Duck' is the feminine gender and its masculine counterpart is 'drake'.
'Duck' স্ত্রীলিঙ্গ এবং এর পুংলিঙ্গ রূপ হলো 'drake'।

questions.question: When Ushashi entered ---- the room, everybody stopped talking.
questions.explanation:
The verb 'enter' is transitive and takes a direct object without any preposition.
'Enter' একটি সকর্মক ক্রিয়া, যা কোনো preposition ছাড়াই সরাসরি কর্ম নেয়।

questions.question: What is the abstract noun form of the word 'Beggar'?
questions.explanation:
The abstract noun form of 'beggar' is 'beggary'.
'Beggar'-এর ভাববাচক বিশেষ্য (abstract noun) রূপ হলো 'beggary'।

questions.question: I wish I were a rich man; I ---- the poor.
questions.explanation:
After 'I wish I were...', the following clause uses 'would/should + base verb'.
'I wish I were...'-এর পরে খণ্ডবাক্যে 'would/should + মূল ক্রিয়া' বসে।

questions.question: The suffix '-hood' can be added to:
questions.explanation:
The suffix '-hood' is added to 'parent' to form 'parenthood'.
'-hood' প্রত্যয়টি 'parent'-এর সাথে যুক্ত হয়ে 'parenthood' গঠন করে।

questions.question: Here ---- book and bag that I lost last week.
questions.explanation:
'Book and bag' is a plural subject, so the plural verb 'are' is used: 'Here are the book and bag...'
'Book and bag' বহুবচন কর্তা, তাই বহুবচন ক্রিয়া 'are' বসে: 'Here are the book and bag...'

questions.question: Change into active voice: 'A lion may be helped even by a little mouse.'
options: A little mouse may even help a lion.
Even a little mouse may help a lion.
A little mouse can even help a lion.
Even a little mouse ought to help a lion.
questions.explanation:
The active voice of 'A lion may be helped even by a little mouse' is 'Even a little mouse may help a lion.'
'A lion may be helped even by a little mouse'-এর active voice হলো 'Even a little mouse may help a lion.'

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation:
'Repeat' already means to say again, so 'Repeat it' is correct without adding 'again'.
'Repeat' অর্থেই আবার বলা বোঝায়, তাই 'again' ছাড়া 'Repeat it' সঠিক।

questions.question: The mob ---- dispersed.
questions.explanation:
'Mob' is a collective noun taken here as a single unit, so it takes the singular verb 'has'.
'Mob' একটি সমষ্টিবাচক বিশেষ্য, এখানে একক সত্তা হিসেবে ধরা হয়েছে, তাই একবচন ক্রিয়া 'has' বসে।

questions.question: I don't mind ---- with the cooking, but I am not going to wash the dishes.
questions.explanation:
The verb 'mind' is followed by a gerund, so 'mind helping' is correct.
'Mind' ক্রিয়ার পরে gerund বসে, তাই 'mind helping' সঠিক।

questions.question: Which gender is the word 'Sibling'?
questions.explanation:
'Sibling' can mean either a brother or a sister, so it is of common gender.
'Sibling' ভাই বা বোন উভয়ই বোঝাতে পারে, তাই এটি common gender।

questions.question: I have never seen ---- airplane before.
questions.explanation:
Before 'a/an + adjective + singular noun' we use 'such', so 'such a large airplane' is correct.
'a/an + বিশেষণ + একবচন বিশেষ্য'-এর আগে 'such' বসে, তাই 'such a large airplane' সঠিক।

questions.question: The boy writes well. Here 'well' is a/an:
questions.explanation:
'Well' here modifies the verb 'writes', so it is an adverb.
এখানে 'well' ক্রিয়া 'writes'-কে modify করছে, তাই এটি adverb।

questions.question: Which of the following words is in the singular form?
questions.explanation:
'Radius' is singular (its plural is 'radii'), while the others are plural forms.
'Radius' একবচন (এর বহুবচন 'radii'), বাকিগুলো বহুবচন রূপ।

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: He dare not to do it.
He dare not to be done it.
questions.explanation:
As a modal, 'dare' is followed by the base verb without 'to', so 'He dare not do it' is correct.
Modal হিসেবে 'dare'-এর পরে 'to' ছাড়া মূল ক্রিয়া বসে, তাই 'He dare not do it' সঠিক।

questions.question: There ---- ten people in the road.
questions.explanation:
'Ten people' is plural, so the plural verb 'were' is used: 'There were ten people...'
'Ten people' বহুবচন, তাই বহুবচন ক্রিয়া 'were' বসে: 'There were ten people...'

questions.question: Which one is the reflexive pronoun?
questions.explanation:
'Himself' is a reflexive pronoun that reflects the action back on the subject.
'Himself' একটি reflexive pronoun, যা ক্রিয়াকে কর্তার দিকে ফিরিয়ে দেয়।

questions.question: ---- losing the first match, our team has won the world cup.
questions.explanation:
"Despite" means "in spite of" and is followed by a noun or gerund (losing), so it correctly begins this sentence; "In spite" is wrong because it must be followed by "of".
"Despite" শব্দের অর্থ "সত্ত্বেও" এবং এর পরে বিশেষ্য বা gerund (losing) বসে, তাই এটি সঠিক; "In spite" ভুল কারণ এর পরে "of" বসাতে হয়।

questions.question: In the sentence 'He ran with great speed', the underlined part 'with great speed' is a ----
questions.explanation:
The phrase "with great speed" tells how he ran and modifies the verb, so it is an adverb phrase.
"with great speed" অংশটি "ran" ক্রিয়াটি কীভাবে সম্পন্ন হলো তা বোঝায়, তাই এটি একটি adverb phrase।

questions.question: Let us love our country. (Make it assertive)
options: We should not hate our country.
We may not hate our country.
questions.explanation:
"Let us" expresses a suggestion, which becomes "should" in the assertive form, giving "We should love our country."
"Let us" দিয়ে প্রস্তাব বোঝানো হয়, যা assertive রূপে "should" হয়, তাই উত্তর "We should love our country."।

questions.question: Which of the following is a correct simple sentence?
options: All that glitters is not gold.
I saw an old man walking past me.
questions.explanation:
A simple sentence has only one subject and one finite verb (one clause); "I saw an old man walking past me." has a single clause, so it is simple.
Simple sentence-এ একটিমাত্র subject ও একটি finite verb (একটি clause) থাকে; "I saw an old man walking past me." বাক্যে একটিমাত্র clause আছে, তাই এটি simple sentence।

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: The man that said that was a fool.
The man who said that was a fool.
The man whom said that was a fool.
The man which said that was a fool.
questions.explanation:
For a person acting as the subject we use the relative pronoun "who", so "The man who said that was a fool" is correct.
ব্যক্তি subject হিসেবে থাকলে relative pronoun "who" ব্যবহৃত হয়, তাই "The man who said that was a fool" সঠিক।

questions.question: I have ---- problems.
questions.explanation:
"a lot of" is the correct quantifier before a plural or uncountable noun; the other forms are ungrammatical.
Plural বা uncountable noun-এর আগে সঠিক quantifier হলো "a lot of"; বাকিগুলো ব্যাকরণসম্মত নয়।

questions.question: Identify the word that can be used as both singular and plural.
questions.explanation:
"cannon" keeps the same form in both singular and plural, so it is the answer.
"cannon" শব্দটির singular ও plural রূপ একই থাকে, তাই এটিই উত্তর।

questions.question: A rolling stone gathers no moss. What is 'rolling'?
questions.explanation:
Here "rolling" comes before the noun "stone" and describes it, so it works as an adjective.
এখানে "rolling" শব্দটি "stone" noun-এর আগে বসে তাকে বিশেষায়িত করছে, তাই এটি adjective হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

questions.question: Which one of the following is a correct proverb?
options: Pen is mightier than a sword
The pen is mightier than sword
A pen is mightier than the sword
The pen is mightier than the sword
questions.explanation:
The correct proverb uses "The" before both "pen" and "sword": "The pen is mightier than the sword."
সঠিক প্রবাদটি "pen" ও "sword" উভয়ের আগে "The" নেয়: "The pen is mightier than the sword."।

questions.question: My father said to me, 'We are going there tomorrow'. The sentence in indirect speech is ----
options: My father told me that they would be going there the next day.
My father said to me that they are going there the next day.
My father told me that they were going there the next day.
My father told me that they are going there the next day.
questions.explanation:
In indirect speech the present continuous "are going" changes to the past continuous "were going", and "tomorrow" becomes "the next day".
Indirect speech-এ present continuous "are going" পরিবর্তিত হয়ে past continuous "were going" হয়, এবং "tomorrow" হয় "the next day"।

questions.question: Alas! I am undone. Here 'alas' is ----
questions.explanation:
"Alas" expresses sudden sorrow, so it is an interjection.
"Alas" আকস্মিক দুঃখ প্রকাশ করে, তাই এটি একটি interjection (আবেগসূচক অব্যয়)।

questions.question: Which one is the correct sentence?
options: Neither roads are led to the railway station.
Neither of the roads lead to the railway station.
Neither of the roads leads to the railway station.
Neither of the roads are leading to the railway station.
questions.explanation:
"Neither of the" is followed by a plural noun but takes a singular verb, so "leads" is correct.
"Neither of the"-এর পরে plural noun বসলেও verb singular হয়, তাই "leads" সঠিক।

questions.question: This could have worked if I ---- been more cautious.
questions.explanation:
This is a third conditional, so the "if" clause needs the past perfect: "if I had been more cautious."
এটি third conditional, তাই "if" clause-এ past perfect বসে: "if I had been more cautious"।

questions.question: Nothing should go unchallenged, ----?
questions.explanation:
"Nothing" is already negative, so the tag question takes a positive form using the same auxiliary: "should it?"
"Nothing" নিজেই negative, তাই tag question-টি একই auxiliary দিয়ে positive রূপে "should it?" হবে।

questions.question: 'We must not be late, else we will miss the train.' What kind of sentence is this?
questions.explanation:
Two independent clauses joined by the connective "else" make it a compound sentence.
"else" সংযোজক দিয়ে দুটি স্বাধীন clause যুক্ত হওয়ায় এটি compound sentence।

questions.question: What is the noun form of the word 'Break'?
questions.explanation:
The noun form of the verb "break" is "breach" or "breakage".
"break" ক্রিয়ার noun রূপ হলো "breach" বা "breakage"।

questions.question: What is the passive form of 'Some children were helping the wounded man.'?
options: The wounded man was being helped by some children.
The wounded man was helped by some children.
The wounded man was helping some children.
The wounded man was to be helped by some children.
questions.explanation:
Past continuous active "were helping" becomes "was being helped" in the passive.
Past continuous active "were helping" passive-এ "was being helped" হয়।

questions.question: Which one is a common noun?
questions.explanation:
"Infant" names any member of a class of persons, so it is a common noun (Salt is material, studentship abstract, army collective).
"Infant" একটি শ্রেণীর যেকোনো সদস্যকে বোঝায়, তাই এটি common noun (Salt material, studentship abstract, army collective)।

questions.question: A lot of food was prepared, but hardly any of it was eaten. Here the underlined words 'hardly any' can be substituted with ----
questions.explanation:
With the uncountable noun "food", "hardly any" means almost none, which equals "little".
uncountable noun "food"-এর সাথে "hardly any" মানে প্রায় কিছুই না, যা "little"-এর সমান।

questions.question: No one can ---- that he is clever.
questions.explanation:
"deny" means to refuse to accept as true, which fits "No one can deny that he is clever."
"deny" অর্থ সত্য বলে মেনে নিতে অস্বীকার করা, যা "No one can deny that he is clever" বাক্যে মানানসই।

questions.question: The ---- board has deleted some scenes.
questions.explanation:
The word is "censor", an official body that removes objectionable parts, so "the censor board" is correct.
শব্দটি "censor", অর্থাৎ আপত্তিকর অংশ বাদ দেওয়ার কর্মকর্তা/সংস্থা, তাই "the censor board" সঠিক।

questions.question: Scarcely had he come ---- it started raining.
questions.explanation:
"Scarcely had ... when" is a fixed correlative structure, so "when" is correct.
"Scarcely had ... when" একটি নির্দিষ্ট correlative গঠন, তাই "when" সঠিক।

questions.question: Which sentence has the correct punctuation?
options: Maria, my student, is on leave to-day
Maria my student, is on leave to-day
Maria my student is on leave to-day
Maria my student is, on leave to-day
questions.explanation:
The appositive "my student" must be set off by a pair of commas, so "Maria, my student, is on leave to-day" is correct.
appositive "my student"-কে দুই পাশে কমা দিয়ে আলাদা করতে হয়, তাই "Maria, my student, is on leave to-day" সঠিক।

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation:
"advice", "luggage" and "information" are uncountable and have no plural, so only "Listen to my advice." is correct.
"advice", "luggage" ও "information" uncountable এবং এদের plural রূপ নেই, তাই কেবল "Listen to my advice." সঠিক।

questions.question: Lingua franca means ----.
questions.explanation:
"Lingua franca" means a common language used between speakers of different mother tongues.
"Lingua franca" অর্থ ভিন্ন ভাষাভাষীদের মধ্যে ব্যবহৃত একটি সাধারণ ভাষা (common language)।

questions.question: What is the comparative form of 'A string of pearls was not so bright as her teeth'?
options: Her teeth was more brighter than a string of pearls.
Her teeth were brighter than a string of pearls.
A string of pearls was brighter than her teeth.
A string of pearls were very bright than her teeth.
questions.explanation:
"not so ... as" becomes "brighter than" in the comparative, and the plural subject "teeth" takes "were".
comparative-এ "not so ... as" হয়ে যায় "brighter than", এবং plural subject "teeth" নেয় "were"।

questions.question: At least one of the students ---- full marks every time.
questions.explanation:
"one of the students" is grammatically singular, so it takes the singular verb "gets".
"one of the students" ব্যাকরণগতভাবে singular, তাই singular verb "gets" বসে।

questions.question: Who is the greatest modern English dramatist?
questions.explanation:
George Bernard Shaw is regarded as the greatest modern English dramatist.
George Bernard Shaw-কে সর্বশ্রেষ্ঠ আধুনিক ইংরেজি নাট্যকার হিসেবে গণ্য করা হয়।

questions.question: The man is too dishonest ----
questions.explanation:
The structure "too ... to" carries a negative sense, so a dishonest man is "too dishonest to speak the truth".
"too ... to" গঠন negative অর্থ দেয়, তাই অসৎ লোকটি "too dishonest to speak the truth"।

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence:
options: I asked Tahmid had he passed.
I asked Tahmid if he had passed.
I asked Tahmid if you had passed.
I asked Tahmid that had he passed.
questions.explanation:
An indirect yes/no question uses "if" and keeps the subject before the verb: "if he had passed."
Indirect yes/no প্রশ্নে "if" ব্যবহৃত হয় এবং subject verb-এর আগে বসে: "if he had passed"।

questions.question: Friendship is nothing but a name. (Make it interrogative)
options: What is friendship but a name?
Is friendship anything but a name?
What is nothing but a name?
questions.explanation:
An affirmative sentence with "nothing but" becomes a negative-idea interrogative with "anything but": "Is friendship anything but a name?"
"nothing but" যুক্ত affirmative বাক্য interrogative-এ "anything but" দিয়ে হয়: "Is friendship anything but a name?"।

questions.question: 'If you read, you will learn'. This sentence is a ---- sentence.
questions.explanation:
The subordinate clause introduced by "if" makes this a complex sentence.
"if" দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া subordinate clause থাকায় এটি complex sentence।

questions.question: If the price is low, demand ----
questions.explanation:
In a first conditional, "if + present" is followed by "will + base verb", so "demand will increase".
First conditional-এ "if + present"-এর পরে "will + base verb" বসে, তাই "demand will increase"।

questions.question: 'A Passage to India' is written by ----
questions.explanation:
"A Passage to India" was written by E. M. Forster.
"A Passage to India" গ্রন্থটি লিখেছেন E. M. Forster।

questions.question: My uncle and benefactor ---- come.
questions.explanation:
"My uncle and benefactor" refers to a single person, so it takes the singular verb "has".
"My uncle and benefactor" একই ব্যক্তিকে বোঝায়, তাই singular verb "has" বসে।

questions.question: What is the passive form of the sentence 'I had written the letter.'?
options: The letter was written by me.
The letter had been written by me.
The letter was being written by me.
The letter was wrote by me.
questions.explanation:
Past perfect active "had written" becomes "had been written" in the passive.
Past perfect active "had written" passive-এ "had been written" হয়।

questions.question: The bell had already been ----
questions.explanation:
The past participle of "ring" is "rung", so "had already been rung" is correct.
"ring"-এর past participle হলো "rung", তাই "had already been rung" সঠিক।

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'Adieu'?
questions.explanation:
"Adieu" means goodbye, so its antonym is "Hello".
"Adieu" অর্থ বিদায়, তাই এর বিপরীত শব্দ "Hello"।

questions.question: What is the plural form of 'Its'?
questions.explanation:
"Its" is the possessive of "it"; its plural (possessive) form is "their".
"Its" হলো "it"-এর possessive; এর plural (possessive) রূপ "their"।

questions.question: Which is the correct sentence?
options: The cost of all these articles have risen
Between you and me affairs look dark
The formation of the paragraphs are very important
questions.explanation:
After the preposition "between" the objective case is used, so "Between you and me" is correct (the others have subject-verb agreement errors).
preposition "between"-এর পরে objective case বসে, তাই "Between you and me" সঠিক (বাকিগুলোতে subject-verb agreement ভুল)।

questions.question: Which of the following is grammatically correct?
options: Do you know where does he live?
Do you know where he lives?
Do you know where does he lives?
Do you know where he lives where?
questions.explanation:
In an embedded question the word order is subject + verb, so "where he lives" is correct.
Embedded question-এ শব্দক্রম হয় subject + verb, তাই "where he lives" সঠিক।

questions.question: 'Five years have passed since his father died.' (Make it simple)
options: His father has died five years ago
His father died five years ago
His father has died for five years
His father died since five years
questions.explanation:
The simple form of this sentence is "His father died five years ago", using the past tense with "ago".
এই বাক্যের simple রূপ হলো "His father died five years ago", যেখানে past tense ও "ago" ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: If I ---- a millionaire, I ---- helped every worthy cause.
questions.explanation:
This is a third conditional: "If I had been a millionaire, I would have helped every worthy cause."
এটি third conditional: "If I had been a millionaire, I would have helped every worthy cause"।

questions.question: All the books have been sold, there ---- left.
questions.explanation:
Here "none" is treated as singular (not a single one), so it takes "is": "there is none left."
এখানে "none" singular ধরা হয় (একটিও নয়), তাই "is" বসে: "there is none left"।

questions.question: I finally killed the fly ---- a rolled-up newspaper.
questions.explanation:
The instrument used to do an action takes the preposition "with", so "with a rolled-up newspaper".
কোনো কাজ করার যন্ত্র/উপকরণ বোঝাতে preposition "with" বসে, তাই "with a rolled-up newspaper"।

questions.question: Everyone should ---- the truth.
questions.explanation:
After the modal "should", the base form of the verb is used, so "should speak".
Modal "should"-এর পরে verb-এর base form বসে, তাই "should speak"।

questions.question: She did not buy it ---- the price was so high.
questions.explanation:
"because" introduces the reason as a clause with a subject and verb, so "because the price was so high".
"because" কারণ বোঝায় এবং এর পরে subject-verb যুক্ত clause বসে, তাই "because the price was so high"।

questions.question: Who is known as 'The Poet of Nature' in English literature?
questions.explanation:
William Wordsworth is known as "The Poet of Nature".
William Wordsworth "The Poet of Nature" নামে পরিচিত।

questions.question: The children who play near the garden water the saplings. Here 'water' is a ----
questions.explanation:
Here "water" takes the object "the saplings" and shows an action, so it is a verb.
এখানে "water" শব্দটি "the saplings" object নেয় ও কাজ বোঝায়, তাই এটি verb।

questions.question: One of the students is studying to be a doctor, but ---- wants to be a musician.
questions.explanation:
When two people are contrasted, the second one is referred to as "the other", so "the other wants to be a musician".
দুইজনের মধ্যে তুলনা করলে দ্বিতীয়জনকে "the other" বলা হয়, তাই "the other wants to be a musician"।

questions.question: The Romantic Age in English literature began with the publication of ----
questions.explanation:
The Romantic Age began with the publication of the "Preface to Lyrical Ballads" by Wordsworth and Coleridge.
Romantic Age শুরু হয়েছিল Wordsworth ও Coleridge-এর "Preface to Lyrical Ballads" প্রকাশের মধ্য দিয়ে।

questions.question: Go and catch the falling star. Here 'falling' is ----
questions.explanation:
"falling" comes before the noun "star" and describes it, so it is an adjective (a participle used as an adjective).
"falling" শব্দটি "star" noun-এর আগে বসে তাকে বিশেষায়িত করছে, তাই এটি adjective।

questions.question: The past form of the verb 'Beat' is ----
questions.explanation:
The verb "beat" has the same form in the past tense: beat–beat–beaten.
"beat" ক্রিয়ার past form একই থাকে: beat–beat–beaten।

questions.question: The passive voice of 'Panic seized me' is ----
options: I was being seized by panic
questions.explanation:
In the passive, "Panic seized me" becomes "I was seized with panic", using "with" for the emotion.
Passive-এ "Panic seized me" হয় "I was seized with panic", যেখানে আবেগ বোঝাতে "with" বসে।

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: Either they or I are wrong
Either they or I is wrong
Either they or I am wrong
Either they or I were wrong
questions.explanation:
With "either ... or", the verb agrees with the nearer subject "I", so "am" is used.
"either ... or"-এর ক্ষেত্রে verb নিকটবর্তী subject "I"-এর সাথে মিল রাখে, তাই "am" বসে।

questions.question: Love the poor, ----?
questions.explanation:
An imperative sentence takes the tag "will you?", so "Love the poor, will you?"
Imperative বাক্যে tag হয় "will you?", তাই "Love the poor, will you?"।

questions.question: We look forward ---- a response from you.
questions.explanation:
"look forward to" is followed by a gerund (verb + ing), so "to receiving".
"look forward to"-এর পরে gerund (verb + ing) বসে, তাই "to receiving"।

questions.question: Runa wants to go home and ----.
questions.explanation:
To express agreement we use "so + auxiliary + subject", so "so do we".
সম্মতি প্রকাশ করতে "so + auxiliary + subject" গঠন ব্যবহৃত হয়, তাই "so do we"।

questions.question: 'The Rape of the Lock' by Alexander Pope is a/an ----
questions.explanation:
"The Rape of the Lock" by Alexander Pope is a mock-heroic poem.
Alexander Pope-এর "The Rape of the Lock" একটি mock-heroic poem।

questions.question: 'If winter comes, can spring be far behind?' is written by ----
questions.explanation:
"If winter comes, can spring be far behind?" is from P. B. Shelley's "Ode to the West Wind".
"If winter comes, can spring be far behind?" পঙ্‌ক্তিটি P. B. Shelley-র "Ode to the West Wind" থেকে নেওয়া।

questions.question: Farhana speaks English fluently; ---- she knows French.
questions.explanation:
"moreover" adds further information, fitting "she speaks English fluently; moreover, she knows French."
"moreover" অতিরিক্ত তথ্য যোগ করে, তাই "moreover, she knows French" সঠিক।

questions.question: The students have submitted the report today which they ---- to bring yesterday.
questions.explanation:
The plural subject "they" needs "were supposed to" to express an expected duty, so "were supposed".
plural subject "they"-এর সাথে প্রত্যাশিত দায়িত্ব বোঝাতে "were supposed to" বসে, তাই "were supposed"।

questions.question: 'May Allah help you.' What kind of sentence is this?
questions.explanation:
A sentence expressing a wish or prayer is an optative sentence, so "May Allah help you." is optative.
ইচ্ছা বা প্রার্থনা প্রকাশক বাক্য optative sentence, তাই "May Allah help you." একটি optative sentence।

questions.question: Many a ---- tried to complete the work.
questions.explanation:
'Many a' is always followed by a singular noun and a singular verb, so 'man has' is correct.
'Many a'-এর পরে সবসময় একবচন বিশেষ্য ও একবচন ক্রিয়া বসে, তাই 'man has' সঠিক।

questions.question: She has ---- her hair a beautiful shade of brown.
questions.explanation:
To change hair colour with dye we use 'dyed', and after 'has' the past participle (V3) is used.
চুলের রং পরিবর্তন করতে 'dyed' ব্যবহৃত হয়, এবং 'has'-এর পরে past participle (V3) বসে।

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is grammatically correct?
options: The horse and carriage are at the door.
Time and tide wait for none.
You are not devoted to gambling.
questions.explanation:
'You are not devoted to gambling' is the only flawless sentence; the others err, e.g. we say 'get up at dawn', not 'in dawn'.
'You are not devoted to gambling' একমাত্র নির্ভুল বাক্য; বাকিগুলোতে ভুল আছে, যেমন 'in dawn' নয়, 'at dawn' হবে।

questions.question: In the sentence 'I know that he will come', the part 'I know' is a/an ----
questions.explanation:
'I know' is the principal (main) clause, not a subordinate clause, so none of the given clause types applies.
'I know' হলো প্রধান (main) clause, কোনো অধীন clause নয়, তাই প্রদত্ত কোনোটিই প্রযোজ্য নয়।

questions.question: I mentioned that he ---- in my room the previous day.
questions.explanation:
The intransitive verb 'lie' (to recline) conjugates lie-lay-lain, so the past perfect is 'had lain'.
অকর্মক ক্রিয়া 'lie' (শোয়া) রূপ পরিবর্তন করে lie-lay-lain, তাই past perfect হবে 'had lain'।

questions.question: Identify the grammatically correct passive sentence.
options: Five men were arrested and one was fined.
Five men was arrested and one was fined.
Five men were being arrested and one was fined.
Five men were arrested and one fined.
questions.explanation:
'Five men were arrested and one was fined' correctly uses plural 'were' for five men and singular 'was' for one.
'Five men were arrested and one was fined' বাক্যে বহুবচনে 'were' ও একবচনে 'was' সঠিকভাবে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

questions.question: In 'Dhaka is a big city', what type of noun is the word 'city'?
questions.explanation:
'City' names a general class of place, so it is a common noun.
'City' একটি সাধারণ শ্রেণির স্থান বোঝায়, তাই এটি common noun (জাতিবাচক বিশেষ্য)।

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: The picture was hanged on the wall.
The picture was hung on the wall.
The picture was hunged on the wall.
The picture had hanged on the wall.
questions.explanation:
For objects we use hang-hung-hung, so 'The picture was hung on the wall' is correct ('hanged' is only for execution).
বস্তুর ক্ষেত্রে hang-hung-hung হয়, তাই 'The picture was hung on the wall' সঠিক ('hanged' কেবল ফাঁসির অর্থে)।

questions.question: Cardiology : Heart :: Psychology : ?
questions.explanation:
Cardiology is the study of the heart, and psychology is the study of behaviour.
Cardiology হৃৎপিণ্ড নিয়ে পড়াশোনা, আর psychology আচরণ (behaviour) নিয়ে পড়াশোনা।

questions.question: We can join two independent sentences by using a ----
questions.explanation:
A semicolon can join two closely related independent clauses into one sentence.
একটি semicolon দুটি ঘনিষ্ঠভাবে সম্পর্কিত স্বাধীন বাক্যকে একটি বাক্যে যুক্ত করতে পারে।

questions.question: Which word is correctly spelt?
questions.explanation:
The correct spelling is 'achievement', following 'i before e except after c'.
সঠিক বানান 'achievement'; 'c'-এর পরে ছাড়া 'i' আগে ও 'e' পরে—এই নিয়মে লেখা হয়।

questions.question: What is the correct comparative form of 'Very few boys are as industrious as Zaman'?
options: Zaman is one of the most industrious boys.
Zaman is more industrious than most other boys.
Zaman is really industrious like other boys.
Zaman is as industrious as other boys.
questions.explanation:
'Very few are as industrious as Zaman' means Zaman is more industrious than most other boys.
'Very few are as industrious as Zaman' মানে Zaman অধিকাংশ ছেলের চেয়ে বেশি পরিশ্রমী।

questions.question: What is the indirect speech of: They said to him, 'Sir, please visit our office today'?
options: They asked him to visit their office today.
They requested him respectfully to visit their office that day.
They requested him respectfully to visit their office today.
They told him humbly to visit their office that day.
questions.explanation:
The polite request with 'Sir/Please' becomes 'requested respectfully', and 'today' changes to 'that day'.
'Sir/Please' সহ বিনীত অনুরোধ 'requested respectfully' হয়, এবং 'today' পরিবর্তিত হয়ে 'that day' হয়।

questions.question: The world ---- a lot by 2099.
questions.explanation:
An action completed by a future point in time takes the future perfect: 'will have changed'.
ভবিষ্যতের একটি নির্দিষ্ট সময়ের মধ্যে সম্পন্ন কাজে future perfect বসে: 'will have changed'।

questions.question: He has a lack ---- money. Fill in the blank with the correct word.
questions.explanation:
The noun 'lack' takes 'of' (lack of money); only the verb form uses 'lacking in'.
বিশেষ্য 'lack'-এর সাথে 'of' বসে (lack of money); কেবল ক্রিয়ারূপে 'lacking in' হয়।

questions.question: What is the indirect speech of: He said, 'What a pity!'?
options: He exclaimed that it is great pity.
He exclaimed that it is very pity.
He exclaimed that it is a great pity.
He exclaimed that it was a great pity.
questions.explanation:
The exclamation becomes 'He exclaimed that it was a great pity', with the tense back-shifted to the past.
বিস্ময়সূচক বাক্যটি হয় 'He exclaimed that it was a great pity', যেখানে কাল অতীতে পরিবর্তিত হয়।

questions.question: Kamal entered the room, sat and ---- his book.
questions.explanation:
To keep the verbs parallel in the simple past, 'opened' matches 'entered' and 'sat'.
সরল অতীত কালে ক্রিয়াগুলো সমান্তরাল রাখতে 'entered' ও 'sat'-এর সাথে 'opened' বসে।

questions.question: In 'My friend hardly works in the afternoon', the word 'hardly' is a/an ----
questions.explanation:
'Hardly' modifies the verb 'works' and means 'scarcely', so it is an adverb.
'Hardly' ক্রিয়া 'works'-কে বিশেষিত করে এবং 'প্রায় না' বোঝায়, তাই এটি একটি adverb।

questions.question: The main character in 'Paradise Lost' Book I and Book II is ----
questions.explanation:
In Books I and II of Milton's 'Paradise Lost', Satan is the central figure.
মিল্টনের 'Paradise Lost'-এর Book I ও Book II-এ Satan হলো কেন্দ্রীয় চরিত্র।

questions.question: An extra message added at the end of a letter after it is signed is called ----
questions.explanation:
A note added after the signature of a letter is called a postscript (P.S.).
চিঠির স্বাক্ষরের পরে যোগ করা বার্তাকে postscript (P.S.) বলা হয়।

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is correct?
questions.explanation:
'Television is a wonderful invention' is grammatically correct and complete.
'Television is a wonderful invention' বাক্যটি ব্যাকরণগতভাবে সঠিক ও সম্পূর্ণ।

questions.question: Where is the setting of the play 'Hamlet'?
questions.explanation:
Shakespeare's 'Hamlet' is set in Denmark.
শেক্সপিয়রের 'Hamlet' নাটকের পটভূমি ডেনমার্ক।

questions.question: Women are too often ---- by family commitments.
questions.explanation:
'Constrained' means restricted or held back, which fits being limited by family commitments.
'Constrained' অর্থ সীমাবদ্ধ বা বাধাপ্রাপ্ত, যা পারিবারিক দায়বদ্ধতায় আটকে পড়ার সাথে মানানসই।

questions.question: Which is the correct English rendering of a sentence meaning that all his efforts came to nothing?
options: All his efforts ended in smoke
All his efforts ended in the smoke
All his efforts in a smoke
All his efforts ended by the smoke
questions.explanation:
The idiom 'to end in smoke' means to come to nothing, so 'All his efforts ended in smoke' is correct.
'to end in smoke' বাগধারার অর্থ ব্যর্থ হওয়া, তাই 'All his efforts ended in smoke' সঠিক।

questions.question: Turn into a simple sentence: 'He said that he was innocent.'
options: He said and he was innocent
That he was innocent was said by him
He was innocent so he said it
questions.explanation:
The complex sentence reduces to the simple sentence 'He declared his innocence'.
জটিল বাক্যটি সরল বাক্যে দাঁড়ায় 'He declared his innocence'।

questions.question: ---- Sandwip is a beautiful island.
questions.explanation:
The name of a single island such as 'Sandwip' takes no article.
'Sandwip'-এর মতো একক দ্বীপের নামের আগে কোনো article বসে না।

questions.question: In 'To win a prize is my ambition', the phrase 'To win a prize' is a/an ----
questions.explanation:
The infinitive phrase 'To win a prize' works as the subject, so it is a noun phrase.
'To win a prize' infinitive phrase-টি বাক্যের কর্তা হিসেবে কাজ করে, তাই এটি একটি noun phrase।

questions.question: I suggest that he ---- there.
questions.explanation:
After 'suggest that', the subjunctive uses the base form of the verb, 'go'.
'suggest that'-এর পরে subjunctive-এ ক্রিয়ার মূল রূপ 'go' বসে।

questions.question: He seems to be happy with his achievement, ----?
questions.explanation:
'Seems' is a present-simple main verb, so its question tag is 'doesn't he?'.
'Seems' একটি present simple মূল ক্রিয়া, তাই এর question tag হবে 'doesn't he?'।

questions.question: If he ---- about her financial condition, he would have helped her out.
questions.explanation:
The third conditional uses 'if + past perfect' with 'would have', so 'had known' is correct.
Third conditional-এ 'if + past perfect' এবং 'would have' বসে, তাই 'had known' সঠিক।

questions.question: Please stop ---- so many mistakes.
questions.explanation:
'Stop' in the sense of ceasing is followed by a gerund, so 'stop making' is correct.
'Stop' (থামা অর্থে)-এর পরে gerund বসে, তাই 'stop making' সঠিক।

questions.question: The very first English dictionary was compiled by ----
questions.explanation:
Samuel Johnson compiled the first authoritative English dictionary in 1755.
Samuel Johnson ১৭৫৫ সালে প্রথম প্রামাণ্য ইংরেজি অভিধান সংকলন করেন।

questions.question: Identify the correct passive form of: 'I heard her sing.'
options: She was heard sing by me.
She was heard to be sung by me.
She was heard sung by me.
She was heard to sing by me.
questions.explanation:
In the passive of a perception verb with a bare infinitive, 'to' is added: 'She was heard to sing by me'.
Perception verb-এর bare infinitive passive-এ 'to' যোগ হয়: 'She was heard to sing by me'।

questions.question: Fortune ---- the brave.
questions.explanation:
This is a universal truth (a proverb), so the simple present 'favours' is used.
এটি একটি চিরন্তন সত্য (প্রবাদ), তাই simple present 'favours' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: What is the masculine gender of 'Mare'?
questions.explanation:
A mare is a female horse; its masculine counterpart is a stallion.
Mare হলো স্ত্রী ঘোড়া; এর পুংলিঙ্গ রূপ হলো stallion।

questions.question: Telling lies is a very bad ----.
questions.explanation:
A repeated personal behaviour such as lying is called a 'habit'.
মিথ্যা বলার মতো বারবার করা ব্যক্তিগত আচরণকে 'habit' (অভ্যাস) বলা হয়।

questions.question: The boy ---- on the floor yesterday.
questions.explanation:
The past tense of the intransitive verb 'lie' (to recline) is 'lay'.
অকর্মক ক্রিয়া 'lie' (শোয়া)-এর past tense হলো 'lay'।

questions.question: What does the idiom 'Black sheep' mean?
questions.explanation:
The idiom 'black sheep' means a disreputable or wicked member of a group.
'black sheep' বাগধারার অর্থ কোনো দলের কুলাঙ্গার বা দুষ্ট ব্যক্তি।

questions.question: The right expression for 'Am I not?' is ----
questions.explanation:
The accepted question tag for 'I am' is 'aren't I?'.
'I am'-এর গৃহীত question tag হলো 'aren't I?'।

questions.question: What is the passive form of 'How can you do this?'
options: How can this be done by you?
How can this been done by you?
How this can be done by you?
How could this be done by you?
questions.explanation:
With a modal, the passive is 'modal + be + past participle': 'How can this be done by you?'.
Modal থাকলে passive হয় 'modal + be + past participle': 'How can this be done by you?'।

questions.question: Neela ---- her hand when she was cooking dinner.
questions.explanation:
The short completed action uses the simple past 'burnt', while the ongoing background action is in the past continuous.
স্বল্পস্থায়ী সম্পন্ন কাজে simple past 'burnt' বসে, আর পটভূমির চলমান কাজটি past continuous-এ থাকে।

questions.question: 'To be, or not to be, that is the question' is a famous soliloquy from ----
questions.explanation:
'To be, or not to be' is the famous soliloquy from Shakespeare's 'Hamlet'.
'To be, or not to be' হলো শেক্সপিয়রের 'Hamlet' নাটকের বিখ্যাত স্বগতোক্তি।

questions.question: What type of noun is 'kindness'?
questions.explanation:
'Kindness' names a quality that cannot be touched, so it is an abstract noun.
'Kindness' একটি অস্পৃশ্য গুণ বোঝায়, তাই এটি abstract noun (গুণবাচক বিশেষ্য)।

questions.question: There ---- several errors.
questions.explanation:
'Errors' is plural, so it takes the plural verb 'have been'.
'Errors' বহুবচন, তাই এর সাথে বহুবচন ক্রিয়া 'have been' বসে।

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is correct?
options: I have a lot of furnitures for sale
The bus service has been cancelled due to fog
questions.explanation:
'Ahsan is better today' is correct; the others have errors, e.g. 'prevented me from going' and 'furniture' has no plural.
'Ahsan is better today' সঠিক; বাকিগুলোতে ভুল আছে, যেমন 'prevented me from going' হবে এবং 'furniture'-এর বহুবচন হয় না।

questions.question: Select the correct sentence.
options: The child has been born yesterday
The child had been born yesterday
questions.explanation:
A birth in the past is expressed in the passive past simple: 'The child was born yesterday'.
অতীতে জন্মের কথা passive past simple-এ বলা হয়: 'The child was born yesterday'।

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is correct?
questions.explanation:
'The man was born in 1968' is grammatically correct and idiomatic.
'The man was born in 1968' বাক্যটি ব্যাকরণগতভাবে সঠিক ও প্রচলিত।

questions.question: 'Ulysses' is a poem written by ----
questions.explanation:
The poem 'Ulysses' was written by Alfred, Lord Tennyson.
'Ulysses' কবিতাটি লিখেছেন Alfred, Lord Tennyson।

questions.question: 'Such a claim needs to be tested empirically' suggests that ----
options: The test should be based on assumption.
The test should be based on idea.
The test should be based on experience.
The test should be based on calculation.
questions.explanation:
'Empirically' means based on observation or experience rather than theory.
'Empirically' অর্থ তত্ত্বের পরিবর্তে পর্যবেক্ষণ বা অভিজ্ঞতার ভিত্তিতে।

questions.question: What is the synonym of 'Bizarre'?
questions.explanation:
'Bizarre' means very strange or odd, so its synonym is 'strange'.
'Bizarre' অর্থ খুব অদ্ভুত বা উদ্ভট, তাই এর সমার্থক শব্দ 'strange'।

questions.question: He divided the money ---- the two children.
questions.explanation:
'Between' is used for two, so 'between the two children' is correct.
দুইয়ের ক্ষেত্রে 'between' বসে, তাই 'between the two children' সঠিক।

questions.question: They are said ---- a dynamic new play.
questions.explanation:
After 'are said', a completed past action uses the perfect infinitive 'to have written'.
'are said'-এর পরে অতীতের সম্পন্ন কাজে perfect infinitive 'to have written' বসে।

questions.question: What is the plural of 'Genus'?
questions.explanation:
The Latin-derived noun 'genus' has the irregular plural 'genera'.
ল্যাটিন থেকে আসা 'genus' শব্দের অনিয়মিত বহুবচন হলো 'genera'।

questions.question: What is the nominative case form of the pronoun 'He'?
questions.explanation:
'He' is itself the nominative (subject) form of the pronoun.
'He' নিজেই সর্বনামটির nominative (কর্তৃকারক) রূপ।

questions.question: In 'The mother sat vigilantly beside the sick baby', the word 'vigilantly' is ----
questions.explanation:
'Vigilantly' modifies the verb 'sat' and ends in -ly, so it is an adverb.
'Vigilantly' ক্রিয়া 'sat'-কে বিশেষিত করে এবং -ly যুক্ত, তাই এটি একটি adverb।

questions.question: 'Sweetly' is a ---- of 'sweet'.
questions.explanation:
'Sweetly' is formed from 'sweet' by adding a suffix, so it is a derivative.
'Sweetly' শব্দটি 'sweet'-এর সাথে প্রত্যয় যোগে গঠিত, তাই এটি একটি derivative।

questions.question: What is the direct speech of 'He said that he had come to see me'?
options: He said, 'He has come to see you!'
He said, 'I have come to see you.'
He said, 'I had come to see you.'
He said, 'I came to see you!'
questions.explanation:
In direct speech it becomes He said, 'I have come to see you', with the pronoun and tense changed accordingly.
প্রত্যক্ষ উক্তিতে এটি হয় He said, 'I have come to see you', যেখানে সর্বনাম ও কাল সেই অনুযায়ী পরিবর্তিত হয়।

questions.question: Who composed 'Paradise Lost'?
questions.explanation:
'Paradise Lost' was composed by John Milton.
'Paradise Lost' রচনা করেছেন John Milton।

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is correct?
options: I suffered from fever for a week.
Let you and he be the witness.
questions.explanation:
'She found the boy crying' is correct; the others err, e.g. 'you and him' and 'Rahim plays'.
'She found the boy crying' সঠিক; বাকিগুলোতে ভুল আছে, যেমন 'you and him' এবং 'Rahim plays' হবে।

questions.question: If you clapped your hands, the crow ---- on the tree branch will fly.
questions.explanation:
The participle 'sitting' reduces the relative clause 'which is sitting' to describe the crow.
Participle 'sitting' মূলত 'which is sitting' relative clause-কে সংক্ষিপ্ত করে কাকটিকে বর্ণনা করে।

questions.question: He is absorbed ---- thought.
questions.explanation:
The fixed expression is 'absorbed in', meaning deeply engaged, so 'in' is correct.
নির্দিষ্ট প্রয়োগটি হলো 'absorbed in', অর্থ গভীরভাবে মগ্ন, তাই 'in' সঠিক।

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: There are trees on the both sides of the road.
There are trees on both the sides of the road.
There are trees, on both side of the road.
There are trees on either sides of the road.
questions.explanation:
'On both the sides of the road' is correct; 'the both sides' and 'either sides' are wrong ('either' takes a singular noun).
'On both the sides of the road' সঠিক; 'the both sides' ও 'either sides' ভুল ('either'-এর পরে একবচন বিশেষ্য বসে)।

questions.question: I decided to go ---- with my friend as I needed some exercise.
questions.explanation:
The idiom is 'go for a walk', so 'for a walk' is correct (not 'for walking').
বাগধারাটি হলো 'go for a walk', তাই 'for a walk' সঠিক ('for walking' নয়)।

questions.question: What is the adjective of the word 'Heart'?
questions.explanation:
'Heartening' is an adjective formed from 'heart', meaning encouraging or gladdening.
'Heartening' হলো 'heart' থেকে গঠিত একটি বিশেষণ, যার অর্থ উৎসাহব্যঞ্জক বা আনন্দদায়ক।

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence:
options: The Airport is a busy place.
questions.explanation:
The correct sentence uses 'The' before 'Airport' and the article 'a' before the singular countable noun 'place'.
সঠিক বাক্যে 'Airport'-এর আগে 'The' এবং singular countable noun 'place'-এর আগে 'a' বসে।

questions.question: Of the four books, the red one is the ----
questions.explanation:
Since four books are being compared, the superlative degree 'cheapest' is used with 'the'.
চারটি বইয়ের মধ্যে তুলনা করা হচ্ছে বলে 'the'-এর সঙ্গে superlative degree 'cheapest' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: Having gained truth, keep truth. Here 'Having gained' is a/an-
questions.explanation:
The structure 'Having + past participle' (having gained) is called a perfect participle.
'Having + past participle' (having gained) কাঠামোটিকে perfect participle বলা হয়।

questions.question: 'Huffing and puffing, we arrived at the classroom door with only seven seconds to spare.' In this sentence the verb 'arrived' is-
questions.explanation:
The verb 'arrived' takes no object, so it is an intransitive verb.
'arrived' ক্রিয়াটির কোনো object নেই, তাই এটি একটি intransitive verb।

questions.question: What is the opposite gender of 'lad'?
questions.explanation:
'Lad' means a young boy, so its opposite gender is 'girl' (a young female).
'Lad' অর্থ কিশোর বা বালক, তাই এর বিপরীত লিঙ্গ হলো 'girl' (কিশোরী বা বালিকা)।

questions.question: Which period is known as 'The golden age of English literature'?
questions.explanation:
The Elizabethan Age (1558-1603) is known as the golden age of English literature.
এলিজাবেথান যুগ (১৫৫৮-১৬০৩) ইংরেজি সাহিত্যের স্বর্ণযুগ হিসেবে পরিচিত।

questions.question: He is so dull that ----
questions.explanation:
The 'so ... that' structure with the present tense 'is' requires 'cannot': He is so dull that he cannot understand anything.
'so ... that' কাঠামোতে present tense 'is'-এর সঙ্গে 'cannot' বসে: He is so dull that he cannot understand anything।

questions.question: 'After lunch we went for a leisurely stroll.' Here 'leisurely' is a/an-
questions.explanation:
'Leisurely' describes the noun 'stroll', so it is an adjective (leisure + ly).
'Leisurely' এখানে 'stroll' নামক noun-কে বিশেষিত করছে, তাই এটি একটি adjective (leisure + ly)।

questions.question: The plural form of personal pronoun 'my' is ----.
questions.explanation:
'My' is the singular first-person possessive; its plural form is 'our'.
'My' হলো একবচন প্রথম পুরুষের possessive; এর বহুবচন রূপ হলো 'our'।

questions.question: The boy said, 'Let me have a pencil.' The indirect speech of the sentence would be-
options: The boy said that he would have a pencil.
The boy said that he might have a pencil.
The boy told that he will have a pencil.
The boy told that he needed a pencil.
questions.explanation:
In indirect speech, 'Let me have' expressing a wish becomes 'might have'.
Indirect speech-এ ইচ্ছা প্রকাশক 'Let me have' পরিবর্তিত হয়ে 'might have' হয়।

questions.question: Fifty kg ---- really a heavy weight to carry.
questions.explanation:
A unit of measurement like 'fifty kg' is treated as singular, so it takes 'is'.
'fifty kg'-এর মতো পরিমাপের একককে singular ধরা হয়, তাই এর সঙ্গে 'is' বসে।

questions.question: 'Animal Farm' was written by-
questions.explanation:
'Animal Farm' was written by George Orwell.
'Animal Farm' উপন্যাসটি লিখেছেন জর্জ অরওয়েল।

questions.question: Cricket enjoys a huge ---- in Bangladesh.
questions.explanation:
'A huge following' (a noun) means a large number of supporters or fans.
'A huge following' (একটি noun) অর্থ বিপুল সংখ্যক সমর্থক বা ভক্ত।

questions.question: Each ---- a trophy for ---- achievement.
questions.explanation:
'Each' is singular, so it takes the singular verb 'has got' and the singular possessive 'his'.
'Each' একবচন, তাই এর সঙ্গে singular verb 'has got' এবং singular possessive 'his' বসে।

questions.question: He went to ---- hospital because he had ---- heart attack.
questions.explanation:
'Go to hospital' takes no article (it shows purpose), and 'a heart attack' takes 'a' because 'heart' begins with a consonant sound.
'Go to hospital' কোনো article নেয় না (উদ্দেশ্য বোঝায়), আর 'heart'-এর ব্যঞ্জনধ্বনির আগে 'a' বসে: 'a heart attack'।

questions.question: ---- best companions in life.
questions.explanation:
The plural subject 'Books' agrees with 'are', and the correct possessive is 'men's': Books are men's best companions in life.
বহুবচন subject 'Books'-এর সঙ্গে 'are' বসে এবং সঠিক possessive হলো 'men's': Books are men's best companions in life।

questions.question: Shakespeare is known/famous mostly for his-
questions.explanation:
Shakespeare is most famous for his plays (dramas).
শেক্সপিয়ার তাঁর নাটকের জন্যই সবচেয়ে বেশি বিখ্যাত।

questions.question: We need as ---- people as possible.
questions.explanation:
'People' is a countable plural noun, so 'as many as' is used.
'People' একটি গণনাযোগ্য বহুবচন noun, তাই 'as many as' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: He asked me why I was late. Here the underlined clause is-
questions.explanation:
The clause 'why I was late' acts as the object of 'asked', so it is a noun clause.
'why I was late' clause-টি 'asked'-এর object হিসেবে কাজ করছে, তাই এটি একটি noun clause।

questions.question: The idiom 'A stitch in time saves nine' refers to the importance of-
questions.explanation:
The idiom means that prompt action prevents bigger trouble, so it stresses timely action.
প্রবাদটির অর্থ, সময়মতো ব্যবস্থা নিলে বড় সমস্যা এড়ানো যায়; তাই এটি সময়োচিত পদক্ষেপের গুরুত্ব বোঝায়।

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence:
options: There is no place for doubt in it.
There is no suspension in it.
There is no room for doubt in it.
There is no misunderstanding in it.
questions.explanation:
The idiomatic English expression is 'There is no room for doubt in it', meaning there is no scope for doubt.
প্রবাদসম্মত সঠিক ইংরেজি বাক্যটি হলো 'There is no room for doubt in it', যার অর্থ এতে সন্দেহের কোনো অবকাশ নেই।

questions.question: 'Light' is to 'dark' as 'cold' is to-
questions.explanation:
This is an analogy of opposites: 'light' is the opposite of 'dark', so 'cold' pairs with 'hot'.
এটি বিপরীত শব্দের সাদৃশ্য: 'light'-এর বিপরীত 'dark', তাই 'cold'-এর বিপরীত 'hot'।

questions.question: What cannot be cured must be endured. (Change into Active voice)
options: We must be endured what we cannot cure.
We cannot cure what we must endure.
We must endure what we cannot cure.
questions.explanation:
The active voice of the sentence is 'We must endure what we cannot cure.'
এই বাক্যের active voice হলো 'We must endure what we cannot cure.'।

questions.question: He addressed Mr. Rahman and wished him good morning. What is the direct speech of the sentence?
options: He said to Mr. Rahman, 'Good morning.'
He said, 'Good morning', to Mr. Rahman.
He said, 'Good morning to Mr. Rahman.'
He bade good morning to Mr. Rahman.
questions.explanation:
The correct direct speech is: He said to Mr. Rahman, 'Good morning.'
এর সঠিক direct speech হলো: He said to Mr. Rahman, 'Good morning.'।

questions.question: Find out the correct passive form of the sentence 'Who taught you English?'
options: By whom were you taught English?
By whom had you been taught English?
By whom had you taught English?
By whom was you taught English?
questions.explanation:
The passive form of 'Who taught you English?' is 'By whom were you taught English?'
'Who taught you English?'-এর passive form হলো 'By whom were you taught English?'।

questions.question: He told me that he ---- in Spain the previous year.
questions.explanation:
In reported speech, the simple past 'worked' shifts back to the past perfect 'had worked'.
Reported speech-এ simple past 'worked' পরিবর্তিত হয়ে past perfect 'had worked' হয়।

questions.question: Which one is the correct sentence?
options: You, he and I must work together
questions.explanation:
The correct pronoun order is 'You, he and I' (2nd, 3rd, 1st person), forming a grammatical sentence.
সঠিক pronoun-এর ক্রম হলো 'You, he and I' (দ্বিতীয়, তৃতীয়, প্রথম পুরুষ), যা ব্যাকরণসম্মত বাক্য গঠন করে।

questions.question: Superlative form of the word 'late' is-
questions.explanation:
'Late' has two superlatives: 'latest' (referring to time) and 'last' (referring to order); 'latest' is the common form.
'Late'-এর দুটি superlative আছে: 'latest' (সময়ের ক্ষেত্রে) এবং 'last' (ক্রমের ক্ষেত্রে); 'latest' বহুল প্রচলিত রূপ।

questions.question: Choose the correct option: Even as harvesting was going on-
questions.explanation:
'Even as' shows two simultaneous past actions, so the simple past 'began' is correct.
'Even as' দুটি একসঙ্গে ঘটা অতীত ঘটনা বোঝায়, তাই simple past 'began' সঠিক।

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence:
questions.explanation:
The simple past 'came' expresses a completed action at a definite past time, so 'You came late today' is correct.
নির্দিষ্ট অতীত সময়ে সম্পন্ন কাজ বোঝাতে simple past 'came' বসে, তাই 'You came late today' সঠিক।

questions.question: After the storm comes the calm. Here the word 'After' is a/an-
questions.explanation:
Here 'After' is followed by the noun phrase 'the storm', so it works as a preposition.
এখানে 'After'-এর পরে 'the storm' noun phrase বসেছে, তাই এটি preposition হিসেবে কাজ করছে।

questions.question: Which of the following is an adverb?
questions.explanation:
'Wisely' (wise + ly) is an adverb, while 'ugly', 'holy' and 'friendly' are adjectives despite ending in -ly.
'Wisely' (wise + ly) একটি adverb, কিন্তু 'ugly', 'holy' ও 'friendly' -ly দিয়ে শেষ হলেও adjective।

questions.question: The real name of O. Henry was ----.
questions.explanation:
The real name of the writer O. Henry was William Sydney Porter.
লেখক ও. হেনরির আসল নাম ছিল উইলিয়াম সিডনি পোর্টার।

questions.question: Choose the best alternative: 'He went back on his promise of voting for me'
questions.explanation:
'Go back on' means to withdraw or fail to keep (a promise), so 'withdrew' is the best synonym.
'Go back on' অর্থ (প্রতিশ্রুতি) প্রত্যাহার করা বা না রাখা, তাই 'withdrew' সবচেয়ে উপযুক্ত সমার্থক শব্দ।

questions.question: Misanthropist means----
options: One who believes that God is in everything
questions.explanation:
A 'misanthropist' is a person who hates or distrusts mankind.
'Misanthropist' হলো এমন ব্যক্তি যে মানবজাতিকে ঘৃণা বা অবিশ্বাস করে।

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: You had better will go there.
questions.explanation:
'Had better' is followed by the base form of the verb (V0), so 'You had better go there' is correct.
'Had better'-এর পরে ক্রিয়ার base form (V0) বসে, তাই 'You had better go there' সঠিক।

questions.question: I have read Milton ---- you admire most.
questions.explanation:
In a defining relative clause, 'that' can refer to a person as well as a thing, so 'that' fits here.
Defining relative clause-এ 'that' ব্যক্তি ও বস্তু উভয়কেই নির্দেশ করতে পারে, তাই এখানে 'that' বসেছে।

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is correct?
options: Have you finished the work yet?
questions.explanation:
'Have you finished the work yet?' correctly uses the present perfect with 'yet' in a question.
'Have you finished the work yet?' বাক্যে প্রশ্নে 'yet'-সহ present perfect সঠিকভাবে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

questions.question: Who is the most famous satirist in English literature?
questions.explanation:
Jonathan Swift, author of 'Gulliver's Travels', is regarded as the most famous satirist in English literature.
'Gulliver's Travels'-এর লেখক জোনাথন সুইফট ইংরেজি সাহিত্যের সবচেয়ে বিখ্যাত ব্যঙ্গরচয়িতা হিসেবে বিবেচিত।

questions.question: He said to her, 'What do you want?' The indirect speech of the sentence will be-
options: He told her what did she want
He asked her what she wanted.
He asked her what does she want
He asked her what did she wanted
questions.explanation:
A reported question uses 'asked' with statement word order and tense back-shift: He asked her what she wanted.
Reported question-এ 'asked' ব্যবহার করে statement-এর মতো শব্দক্রম ও tense পরিবর্তন হয়: He asked her what she wanted।

questions.question: The team of doctors ---- arriving to the hospital soon.
questions.explanation:
The collective noun 'team' is treated as singular here and fits the present continuous, so 'is' is used.
সমষ্টিবাচক noun 'team'-কে এখানে singular ধরা হয়েছে এবং present continuous-এর সঙ্গে 'is' বসে।

questions.question: The synonym of the word 'Doleful' is ----.
questions.explanation:
'Doleful' means sad or sorrowful, so its synonym is 'mournful'.
'Doleful' অর্থ দুঃখার্ত বা বিষণ্ন, তাই এর সমার্থক শব্দ হলো 'mournful'।

questions.question: As soon as the teacher enters the classroom, the students stand up. (Change into Negative)
options: No sooner does the teacher enter the classroom than the students stand up
No sooner the teacher enter the classroom than the students stand up
No sooner had the teacher entered the classroom than the students stood up
The students stood up as the teacher entered the classroom
questions.explanation:
'As soon as' is changed to the negative structure 'No sooner had ... than ...': No sooner had the teacher entered the classroom than the students stood up.
'As soon as' পরিবর্তিত হয়ে negative গঠন 'No sooner had ... than ...' হয়: No sooner had the teacher entered the classroom than the students stood up।

questions.question: ---- among you are from class XII?
questions.explanation:
For people acting as the subject, 'Who' is used: Who among you are from class XII?
কর্তা হিসেবে ব্যক্তি বোঝাতে 'Who' ব্যবহৃত হয়: Who among you are from class XII?।

questions.question: 'Justice delayed is justice denied' was stated by-
questions.explanation:
The statement 'Justice delayed is justice denied' is attributed to William E. Gladstone.
'Justice delayed is justice denied' উক্তিটি উইলিয়াম ই. গ্ল্যাডস্টোনের বলে মনে করা হয়।

questions.question: There is ---- tea in the cup.
questions.explanation:
'Tea' is an uncountable noun, so 'very little' is used to indicate a small amount.
'Tea' একটি uncountable noun, তাই অল্প পরিমাণ বোঝাতে 'very little' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: Which expression is correct?
questions.explanation:
'Cattle' takes no plural 's'; the correct counting expression is 'ten head of cattle'.
'Cattle'-এর সঙ্গে বহুবচনের 's' বসে না; সঠিক প্রকাশ হলো 'ten head of cattle'।

questions.question: Which of the following is the adjective of the word 'Might'?
questions.explanation:
The adjective of the noun 'Might' is 'Mighty'.
'Might' noun-টির adjective রূপ হলো 'Mighty'।

questions.question: Identify the determiner: 'Will it take much time?'
questions.explanation:
'Much' indicates the quantity of the noun 'time', so it is a determiner.
'Much' এখানে 'time' noun-এর পরিমাণ বোঝাচ্ছে, তাই এটি একটি determiner।

questions.question: It is essential that the patient ---- medicine regularly.
questions.explanation:
After 'It is essential that', the subjunctive base form 'take' is used.
'It is essential that'-এর পরে subjunctive base form 'take' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: Othello gave Desdemona ---- as a token of love.
questions.explanation:
In Shakespeare's play 'Othello', Othello gave Desdemona a handkerchief as a token of love.
শেক্সপিয়ারের নাটক 'Othello'-তে ওথেলো ডেসডিমোনাকে ভালোবাসার নিদর্শন হিসেবে একটি রুমাল দিয়েছিলেন।

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: She is a person whom I know is sincere.
She is a person who I know is sincere
There is no place in my class.
questions.explanation:
'Who' is the subject of 'is sincere' ('I know' is parenthetical), so 'who' is correct, not 'whom'.
'Who' এখানে 'is sincere'-এর কর্তা ('I know' অংশটি ঊহ্য), তাই 'whom' নয়, 'who' সঠিক।

questions.question: He died ---- over eating.
questions.explanation:
'Die from' is used for causes such as a habit or overeating: He died from over eating.
অভ্যাস বা অতিভোজনের মতো কারণ বোঝাতে 'die from' ব্যবহৃত হয়: He died from over eating।

questions.question: Choose the right question to 'I have been to Laos.'
questions.explanation:
The present perfect answer 'I have been to Laos' matches the present perfect question 'Have you been to Laos?'
Present perfect উত্তর 'I have been to Laos'-এর সঙ্গে present perfect প্রশ্ন 'Have you been to Laos?' মানানসই।

questions.question: The man standing in front of you is a professor. The underlined phrase is a/an-
questions.explanation:
The phrase 'standing in front of you' describes the noun 'man', so it is an adjective phrase.
'standing in front of you' phrase-টি 'man' noun-কে বিশেষিত করছে, তাই এটি একটি adjective phrase।

questions.question: Article is used based on----
questions.explanation:
The article 'a/an' is chosen according to the pronunciation (initial sound) of the following word, not its spelling.
'a/an' article পরবর্তী শব্দের বানান নয়, উচ্চারণ (ধ্বনি) অনুসারে নির্ধারিত হয়।

questions.question: Man did not know that the earth moves round the sun until it was-
questions.explanation:
Existing natural facts, like the earth's motion, are 'discovered', not invented.
পৃথিবীর গতির মতো পূর্ব থেকে বিদ্যমান প্রাকৃতিক সত্য 'discovered' (আবিষ্কৃত) হয়, 'invented' নয়।

questions.question: Choose the correct spelling.
questions.explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Bouquet' (a bunch of flowers).
সঠিক বানান হলো 'Bouquet' (ফুলের তোড়া)।

questions.question: What is all this noise? The underlined word 'all' is a/an-
questions.explanation:
Here 'all' modifies the noun 'noise', so it functions as an adjective.
এখানে 'all' শব্দটি 'noise' noun-কে বিশেষিত করছে, তাই এটি adjective হিসেবে কাজ করছে।

questions.question: He has been ill ---- Friday last.
questions.explanation:
With the present perfect and a point of time (Friday last), 'since' is used.
Present perfect ও নির্দিষ্ট সময়বিন্দু (Friday last)-এর সঙ্গে 'since' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: 'All at once' means----
questions.explanation:
The idiom 'all at once' means 'suddenly'.
'All at once' বাগধারাটির অর্থ 'হঠাৎ'।

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: Had I been a king, I would have helped the poor.
If I were you, I would not do this.
If I were you, I would not have done this.
questions.explanation:
The inverted third conditional 'Had I been a king, I would have helped the poor' is grammatically correct.
উল্টানো third conditional 'Had I been a king, I would have helped the poor' বাক্যটি ব্যাকরণসম্মত।

questions.question: 'Good' is to 'bad' as 'White' is to ----
questions.explanation:
'Good' and 'bad' are antonyms, and likewise the opposite of 'white' is 'black'.
'Good' ও 'bad' পরস্পর বিপরীতার্থক শব্দ, তেমনি 'white'-এর বিপরীত শব্দ হলো 'black'।

questions.question: Which period is known as 'The Golden Age of English Literature'?
questions.explanation:
The Elizabethan Age, the reign of Queen Elizabeth I, is called the Golden Age of English Literature.
রানি প্রথম এলিজাবেথের শাসনকাল তথা এলিজাবেথান যুগকে ইংরেজি সাহিত্যের স্বর্ণযুগ বলা হয়।

questions.question: 'The French' refers to ----
questions.explanation:
'The French' with a definite article refers to the French people as a nation.
'The French' বলতে সমগ্র ফরাসি জাতি বা ফরাসি জনগণকে বোঝায়।

questions.question: The person ---- in the Padma.
questions.explanation:
A living being 'drowns' in water, whereas objects 'sink'; so the correct word is 'drowned'.
মানুষ বা প্রাণী পানিতে 'drown' করে, আর জড় বস্তু 'sink' করে; তাই সঠিক শব্দ 'drowned'।

questions.question: What is the correct English version of the sentence meaning 'Extinguish the light'?
questions.explanation:
'Put out' is a phrasal verb meaning to extinguish, so 'Put out the light' is correct.
